<style>
.contact_form-input_field:focus,
.contact_form-input_field:active {
  outline: 2px solid #7142b9;
  outline-offset: -2px !important;
}
  
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
  
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form input.footer_form-text {
  flex: 85%;
  background-color: #fff0 !important;
  color: var(--purple--light-purple) !important;
  border-radius: 0px;
}
  
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form input:-webkit-autofill,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form input:-webkit-autofill:hover, 
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form textarea:-webkit-autofill,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form textarea:-webkit-autofill:hover,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form textarea:-webkit-autofill:focus,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form select:-webkit-autofill,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form select:-webkit-autofill:hover,
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form select:-webkit-autofill:focus {
  background-color: #fff0 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--purple--light-purple) !important;
  -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1000px #fff0 inset;
  transition: background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
}
  
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form input[type=submit] { 
  flex: 15%;
}
  
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form p.warning-message {
  flex: 100%;
  color: #79fbbc !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
}
  
.footer_form-wrapper form#wf-form-Footer-email-form input[disabled] { 
  background-color: #2c2c2c00 !important;
}
</style>

Here are the latest AI breakthroughs and news that are shaping the world around us!</div></div><div class="blogrichtext w-richtext"><h1>The Latest AI Breakthroughs, News, and Developments</h1><p>Wondering what’s happening in the AI world? Here is the list of the latest AI breakthroughs, news,and developments you must be aware of. </p><p><em>Also checkout our exclusive coverage on: </em><a href="https://www.crescendo.ai/news/ai-in-healthcare-news" data-wf-native-id-path="490218c3-55f3-5fcc-9eda-faca3e443b46" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="490218c3-55f3-5fcc-9eda-faca3e443b46"><em>The Latest AI news in Healthcare Industry</em></a></p><h3>(Agentic AI) Agentic AI Governance Framework for Banking, Healthcare, Retail & Supply Chain — Yale CELI</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: May 2, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary</strong>: Yale's Chief Executive Leadership Institute (CELI) published a cross-industry governance framework for agentic AI, prompted in part by the capabilities of Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview model and the autonomous risks it exposed. The framework identifies eight governance variables — transparency, accountability, bias, data privacy, decision reversibility, stakeholder impact scope, regulatory prescription, and structural governability — and applies them across four industry archetypes: banking (dynamic but heavily regulated), healthcare (high-stakes, bifurcated adoption), retail (low barriers, fast iteration), and supply chain (architecturally consequential). The authors argue that while regulatory frameworks are still catching up, private-sector governance built today will become the templates other industries adopt tomorrow.</p><p><strong>Source: </strong><a href="https://fortune.com/2026/05/02/agentic-ai-governance-framework-banking-healthcare-retail-supply-chain-yale-celi-sonnenfeld/" data-wf-native-id-path="2a510620-c406-5a0e-76ca-aacaf77b3303" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="2a510620-c406-5a0e-76ca-aacaf77b3303" data-cmp-ab="2">Fortune ↗</a></p><h3>AI Breakthrough Solves One of Science's Most Challenging Math Problems</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: May 1, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary</strong>: Researchers at the University of Pennsylvania's School of Engineering introduced "Mollifier Layers," a novel technique that integrates classical mathematical smoothing functions into neural networks to solve inverse partial differential equations (PDEs) with far greater stability and efficiency. The method addresses a longstanding challenge in scientific AI, where high-order derivative computations in noisy real-world data tend to fail. Applications span genomics, materials science, climate modeling, and chromatin biology, with findings set to appear in Transactions on Machine Learning Research and to be presented at NeurIPS 2026.</p><p><strong>Source</strong>:<a href="https://bioengineer.org/ai-breakthrough-solves-one-of-sciences-most-challenging-math-problems/" data-wf-native-id-path="49d62f47-de0c-d433-5cae-5d5feb1dba77" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="49d62f47-de0c-d433-5cae-5d5feb1dba77" data-cmp-ab="2"> Bioengineer.org</a></p><h3>(Agentic AI) US and Allies Issue Joint Guidance on Agentic AI System Security</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: May 1, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary</strong>: The cybersecurity and intelligence agencies of the United States, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom jointly released a guidance document titled "Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services," addressing security risks in agentic AI systems deployed in critical infrastructure and defense environments. The guidance identifies five categories of risk — privilege, design and configuration, behavior, structural, and accountability — and outlines best practices across the full AI lifecycle, from designing and deploying secure agents to managing third-party components. Agencies stress that organizations should deploy incrementally, maintain strong governance, and ensure rigorous monitoring and continuous human oversight.</p><p><strong>Source: </strong><a href="https://www.executivegov.com/articles/agentic-ai-security-guidance-us-australia-canada-nz-uk" data-wf-native-id-path="20c90a60-ecf8-77ff-46d5-8c884e56efed" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="20c90a60-ecf8-77ff-46d5-8c884e56efed" data-cmp-ab="2">ExecutiveGov ↗</a></p><h3>(Agentic AI) Accenture Invests in Netomi to Accelerate Enterprise Adoption of Agentic AI for Customer Experience</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: April 30, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary</strong>: Accenture, through Accenture Ventures, announced a strategic investment in Netomi, a customer experience AI platform, forming a partnership to help enterprises reinvent customer service using agentic AI. Netomi's no-code orchestration platform deploys coordinated AI agents that anticipate customer needs and take action across multiple channels while maintaining governance and brand compliance. The partnership embeds Netomi's platform into existing enterprise technologies without operational disruption. A recent Accenture report found that 87% of respondents are likely to avoid a brand after a single negative experience, underscoring the urgency of smarter, more responsive service solutions at scale.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://newsroom.accenture.com/news/2026/accenture-invests-in-netomi-to-accelerate-enterprise-adoption-of-agentic-ai-for-customer-experience" data-wf-native-id-path="d5277d64-b17c-61d4-2c3a-b9a790f4ca1d" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d5277d64-b17c-61d4-2c3a-b9a790f4ca1d" data-cmp-ab="2">Accenture Newsroom ↗</a></p><h3>JPMorgan Chase Reclassifies AI as Core Infrastructure in $19.8 Billion Tech Budget</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: April 30, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary</strong>: JPMorgan Chase formally reclassified its AI investments from experimental R&D to core infrastructure, with a 2026 technology budget of approximately $19.8 billion and 2,000 staff dedicated to AI development. The bank is focusing on three areas: boosting internal productivity through AI agents, hardening cybersecurity defenses, and personalizing retail banking. AI is projected to generate $2.5 billion in annual value for the bank through efficiency gains and revenue growth, with models already scanning over $10 trillion in daily transactions.</p><p><strong>Source</strong>:<a href="https://www.llrx.com/2026/04/ai-in-finance-and-banking-april-30-2026/" data-wf-native-id-path="25efc167-15ea-4824-1001-fa4dfd7f83e1" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="25efc167-15ea-4824-1001-fa4dfd7f83e1" data-cmp-ab="2"> LLRX</a></p><h3>AI Outperforms Doctors at Diagnosing Patients in Real-World Study</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: April 30, 2026</p><p>Summary: A study published in Science by researchers at Harvard Medical School and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center found that an OpenAI reasoning model outperformed experienced physicians at diagnosing patients and managing their care, using only electronic health records from a Boston emergency department. The AI was tested at three stages of patient triage, from initial ER intake to hospital admission, and consistently matched or exceeded physician accuracy. Researchers noted the model's marked improvement over earlier AI tools, particularly in handling diagnostic uncertainty.</p><p><strong>Source</strong>:<a href="https://www.npr.org/2026/04/30/nx-s1-5804474/ai-doctors-openai-patient-care-diagnosis" data-wf-native-id-path="d271d623-47a7-20a5-52c4-1ee5f56d36b5" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d271d623-47a7-20a5-52c4-1ee5f56d36b5" data-cmp-ab="2"> NPR</a></p><h3>McKinsey and ICSC Report: AI-Mediated Commerce Could Put $1 Trillion in US Retail at Stake</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: April 27, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> A joint report from ICSC and McKinsey, based on a survey of 3,004 US consumers and interviews with retail and real estate leaders, found that AI agents are reshaping where and how shopping decisions are made, with McKinsey estimating up to $1 trillion in US B2C retail revenue could be influenced by agentic commerce by 2030. Store visits are becoming less frequent but more purposeful, with consumers arriving with greater intent after using AI tools to narrow their choices. The report urges retailers to redesign stores around a clear purpose, optimizing for either speed and convenience or experiential discovery.</p><p><strong>Source</strong>:<a href="https://lasvegassun.com/news/2026/apr/27/icsc-mckinsey-company-release-shopping-in-the-age-/" data-wf-native-id-path="586ddc96-b0f7-41dd-6938-7ca6a134d977" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="586ddc96-b0f7-41dd-6938-7ca6a134d977" data-cmp-ab="2"> Las Vegas Sun / Business Wire</a></p><h3>(Agentic AI) Amazon Connect Expands into a Set of Agentic AI Solutions for Business</h3><p><strong>Date</strong>: April 24, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary</strong>: AWS announced the expansion of Amazon Connect into four purpose-built agentic AI solutions: Amazon Connect Decisions (supply chain optimization), Amazon Connect Talent (AI-driven hiring), Amazon Connect Customer (customer engagement, the renamed original Amazon Connect), and Amazon Connect Health (healthcare administration). The move solidifies the deep strategic partnership between Samsung and Google as they compete to set the industry standard for on-device AI experiences, focusing on real-time translation, sophisticated image editing, and proactive digital assistance across the global Android ecosystem.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.reuters.com/world/china/samsung-double-mobile-devices-powered-by-googles-gemini-800-mln-units-this-year-2026-01-05/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cd93" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cd93" data-cmp-ab="2"> Reuters ↗</a></p><h3>Hyundai Motor Group Unveils New AI-Driven Strategy for Human-Centered Robotics</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> At CES 2026, Hyundai Motor Group detailed its comprehensive "AI+Robotics" roadmap, aiming to establish a leadership position in the emerging human-centered robotics market. The strategy focuses on integrating advanced large language models and generative AI into mobile robots to enable more natural interaction with human environments. Key highlights include the introduction of a new modular robot platform designed for logistics and personal assistance, as well as an expanded partnership with Boston Dynamics to develop AI systems that enhance autonomous navigation and dexterity. Hyundai's vision emphasizes robots as "intelligent companions" that can adapt to complex social settings, moving beyond simple automation to collaborative roles in daily life.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/hyundai-motor-group-announces-ai-robotics-strategy-to-lead-human-centered-robotics-era-at-ces-2026-302653240.html" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cda2" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cda2" data-cmp-ab="2"> PR Newswire ↗</a></p><h3>Trilogy Debuts AI Manuscript Evaluation Tool for the Publishing Industry</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> Trilogy, a technology company specializing in publishing solutions, has launched a new AI-powered platform designed to assist publishers in the early-stage assessment of manuscripts. The tool utilizes machine learning to analyze text for structural integrity, pacing, and market trends, providing editors with a data-driven overview of a submission's potential. While the company maintains that the software is intended to augment rather than replace human editorial judgment, the platform aims to significantly reduce the time spent on "slush pile" management by highlighting high-potential works that align with a publisher's specific catalog and current reader demand.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/by-topic/industry-news/publisher-news/article/99343-trilogy-launches-ai-powered-manuscript-assessment-tool-for-publishers.html" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdb2" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdb2" data-cmp-ab="2"> Publishers Weekly ↗</a></p><h3>Maryland Secures Federal AI Grants to Enhance Public Benefit Systems</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> The state of Maryland has been awarded new federal grants to integrate artificial intelligence into its delivery of essential public services, including SNAP, Medicaid, and unemployment insurance. The initiative focuses on using AI-driven automation to streamline the application process, reduce backlogs, and improve the accuracy of eligibility determinations. State officials aim to leverage these tools to provide faster assistance to residents while identifying potential fraud more effectively. The project is part of a broader push to modernize state infrastructure, ensuring that high-volume social safety net programs can operate with greater efficiency and responsiveness to citizen needs.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.governing.com/artificial-intelligence/maryland-secures-ai-grants-to-improve-snap-medicaid-unemployment-services" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdc1" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdc1" data-cmp-ab="2"> Governing ↗</a></p><h3>Automotive Retailers Begin Full-Scale Integration of AI Tools</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> The automotive retail sector is reaching a turning point as disparate artificial intelligence applications begin to merge into a cohesive operational ecosystem. Dealerships are moving beyond simple chatbots to integrated systems that handle everything from predictive inventory management to highly personalized sales outreach. Industry analysts suggest that the "pieces are coming together" for a frictionless digital-to-physical customer journey, where AI analyzes vast amounts of consumer data to optimize pricing and streamline the service department. This transition marks a shift from experimental tech to a fundamental transformation in how vehicles are sold and maintained.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.autonews.com/retail/an-column-ai-pieces-coming-together-0105/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdd0" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdd0" data-cmp-ab="2"> Automotive News ↗</a></p><h3>NVIDIA Debuts "Vera Rubin" as Next-Generation AI Architecture at CES 2026</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> During its CES 2026 keynote, NVIDIA officially unveiled its latest flagship AI platform, codenamed "Vera Rubin." Following the Blackwell architecture, the Rubin platform introduces radical improvements in processing power and memory bandwidth, specifically engineered to handle the massive scaling requirements of trillion-parameter models. Named after the pioneering astronomer, the architecture features the new H300 GPUs and a dedicated AI foundry for custom silicon, signaling NVIDIA's intent to maintain its dominant lead in the global AI hardware race. The platform is expected to enter full production later this year to support the next wave of sovereign and enterprise AI infrastructure.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://finance.yahoo.com/news/nvidia-launches-vera-rubin-its-next-major-ai-platform-at-ces-2026-230045205.html" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cddf" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cddf" data-cmp-ab="2"> Yahoo Finance ↗</a></p><h3>Apple Confirms Major AI Overhaul for Siri Launching in 2026</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> Apple has officially announced that a completely reimagined, AI-powered version of Siri is set to debut in 2026. This fundamental transformation will see Siri transition into a context-aware assistant capable of "on-screen awareness" and seamless cross-app integration. To power these advanced capabilities, Apple is adopting a unique strategy by partnering with Google to utilize its 1.2 trillion parameter Gemini AI model, running on Apple’s Private Cloud Compute to maintain strict privacy standards. The update is targeted for a March 2026 release alongside iOS 26.4, following rigorous internal testing to ensure the new system meets Apple’s reliability and quality benchmarks.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://apple.gadgethacks.com/news/apples-new-ai-powered-siri-finally-coming-in-2026/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdee" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdee" data-cmp-ab="2"> Gadget Hacks ↗</a></p><h3>UK Regulators Demand Clarity from xAI Over Grok’s Synthetic Image Safety</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> The UK’s Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) and the communications regulator Ofcom have issued a formal demand to Elon Musk’s xAI for information regarding its "Grok" AI model. The inquiry focuses on concerns that the model's image-generation capabilities could be exploited to create non-consensual sexualized content and "deepfake" imagery. British authorities are seeking detailed explanations on the safety guardrails in place to prevent the generation of harmful material, warning that failure to comply with the country's stringent Online Safety Act could result in significant fines or restrictions on the service.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/britain-demands-elon-musks-grok-answers-concerns-about-sexualised-photos-2026-01-05/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdfe" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593cdfe" data-cmp-ab="2"> Reuters ↗</a></p><h3>Arkansas to Deploy AI-Powered Cameras for Work Zone Safety Enforcement</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> Arkansas state officials have announced the upcoming installation of new AI-powered camera technology designed to detect drivers using handheld cell phones in highway work zones. Building on existing speed enforcement systems permitted under Act 707, these updated cameras use artificial intelligence to identify specific visual indicators, such as a phone in a driver's hand, while ignoring hands-free Bluetooth usage. The Arkansas Department of Transportation (ARDOT) emphasized that the initiative is focused solely on saving lives following several recent worker fatalities, rather than generating revenue. Enforcement is expected to begin in mid-January, though the move has sparked debates regarding driver privacy and the scope of the original legislation.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.ktalnews.com/video/arkansas-to-install-ai-powered-cameras/11400628/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce0d" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce0d" data-cmp-ab="2"> KTAL News ↗</a></p><h3>BNY Mellon Implements Massive 20,000-Agent AI Literacy Program</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> BNY Mellon has launched a sweeping initiative to deploy 20,000 AI agents across its global workforce to enhance institutional AI literacy and operational efficiency. This "agent-first" strategy involves equipping employees with specialized digital assistants designed to automate repetitive financial analysis, data reconciliation, and compliance reporting tasks. Rather than replacing staff, the bank aims to elevate the "AI IQ" of its workforce by integrating these agents into daily workflows, allowing human employees to focus on high-level strategic decision-making. This move positions BNY Mellon at the forefront of the financial sector's shift toward agentic AI ecosystems.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.google.com/search?q=https://startuphub.ai/ai-news/ai-video/2026/bny-mellon-scales-ai-literacy-the-20000-agent-strategy/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce1c" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce1c" data-cmp-ab="2"> StartupHub.ai ↗</a></p><h3>Vistra Secures $4 Billion Gas Fleet to Power Rising AI Electricity Demands</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 5, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> Vistra Corp. has reached a $4 billion agreement to acquire a massive fleet of gas-fired power plants in the United States, a strategic move aimed at addressing the soaring energy needs of the artificial intelligence sector. As the expansion of AI data centers puts unprecedented pressure on the national power grid, Vistra is positioning itself as a critical infrastructure provider by securing reliable, "always-on" fossil fuel generation to complement its nuclear and renewable portfolios. This acquisition underscores the growing reality that the AI revolution is driving a significant resurgence in demand for natural gas power to ensure 24/7 operational stability for high-performance computing facilities.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-01-05/vistra-to-buy-big-us-gas-powered-fleet-for-4-billion" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce2b" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce2b" data-cmp-ab="2"> Bloomberg ↗</a></p><h3>Boston Dynamics Utilizes AI to Train Humanoid Robots for Industrial Roles</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 4, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> Boston Dynamics is significantly advancing the capabilities of its humanoid robots by integrating reinforcement learning and large-scale AI training to prepare them for real-world labor. In a recent demonstration, the company showcased its new fully electric Atlas model performing complex, autonomous tasks such as moving automotive parts in a factory setting. Unlike previous iterations that relied on rigid programming, these new AI-driven humanoids can adapt to shifting environments and unexpected obstacles. The initiative reflects a strategic push toward deploying robots in commercial industries to handle repetitive or hazardous jobs alongside human workers.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.cbsnews.com/news/boston-dynamics-training-ai-humanoids-to-perform-human-jobs-60-minutes/" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce3a" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce3a" data-cmp-ab="2"> CBS News ↗</a></p><h3>OpenAI Warns of Unfixable Prompt Injection Risks in AI Browsing Systems</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 4, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> OpenAI has officially acknowledged that prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions are hidden within web content to manipulate AI agents, represent a structural security risk that cannot be fully patched. As tools like the ChatGPT Atlas browser gain more autonomy to navigate the web and scan documents, they become vulnerable to these "indirect" injections that trick the AI into performing unauthorized actions without user knowledge. To combat this, OpenAI is deploying a specialized "automated attacker" bot to proactively find weaknesses, while urging users to maintain strict human oversight and limit the data access granted to autonomous AI agents.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.foxnews.com/tech/openai-admits-ai-browsers-face-unsolvable-prompt-attacks" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce49" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce49" data-cmp-ab="2"> Fox News ↗</a></p><h3>Alaska Court System Limits AI Chatbot Usage After Technical Difficulties</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 3, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> The Alaska Court System has scaled back its experimental AI chatbot project following a series of technical hurdles and concerns over the accuracy of legal information provided to the public. Initially launched to assist self-represented litigants in navigating complex court procedures, the tool struggled with the nuances of specific state laws and occasionally provided inconsistent guidance. Judicial officials noted that while the technology showed promise for increasing access to justice, the "hallucination" of legal facts posed a significant risk, leading to a decision to move back toward human-verified resources until the system can be further refined.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/alaskas-court-system-built-ai-chatbot-didnt-go-smoothly-rcna235985" data-wf-native-id-path="e08f08d3-58db-f1b9-9153-a3077e20ccf8" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="e08f08d3-58db-f1b9-9153-a3077e20ccf8" data-cmp-ab="2"> NBC News ↗</a></p><h3>European Banking Sector Faces Potential Loss of 200,000 Jobs to AI Automation</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 2, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> A new report highlights a sobering forecast for the European financial industry, suggesting that up to 200,000 jobs could be eliminated as banks accelerate the integration of generative AI. The shift is driven by the industry's need to cut costs and improve efficiency in high-volume areas such as customer service, back-office operations, and basic financial analysis. While some institutions are focusing on retraining programs, the rapid advancement of "agentic" AI—capable of performing complex tasks autonomously—has led analysts to predict a significant workforce reduction over the coming years. This potential mass layoff underscores the growing tension between technological innovation and traditional employment stability in the global banking sector.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.computerworld.com/article/4112389/european-banks-may-lay-off-200000-due-to-ai.html" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce58" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce58" data-cmp-ab="2"> Computerworld ↗</a></p><h3>Google’s AI Search Overviews Under Scrutiny for Spreading Harmful Health Data</h3><p><strong>Date:</strong> January 2, 2026</p><p><strong>Summary:</strong> Medical experts and safety advocates are raising urgent alarms regarding Google’s "AI Overviews," which have been found to occasionally provide dangerously misleading health advice. Despite Google's efforts to implement safety guardrails, reports indicate the system has surfaced inaccurate treatment recommendations and misinterpreted diagnostic data for critical conditions. Critics argue that the authoritative tone of the AI-generated summaries may lead users to bypass professional medical consultation, potentially resulting in delayed care or self-treatment based on synthetic misinformation. The backlash has prompted calls for stricter regulatory oversight of AI search features that provide high-stakes information to the general public.</p><p><strong>Source:</strong><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jan/02/google-ai-overviews-risk-harm-misleading-health-information" data-wf-native-id-path="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce66" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="d060b0be-6af3-d0dc-403e-4d2eb593ce66" data-cmp-ab="2"> The Guardian ↗</a></p><p>‍</p><p>‍</p><p>‍</p><p>‍</p></div><div class="w-condition-invisible"><div class="padding_bottom padding-3rem"></div><div id="mc_cta" class="news_cta-card"><div class="mc_cta_links"><div class="heading-medium font-color-white w-dyn-bind-empty"></div><div class="padding_bottom padding-1rem"></div><a data-wf-native-id-path="900f12fc-8696-6c57-e0ba-2e5ac6ad5f41" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="900f12fc-8696-6c57-e0ba-2e5ac6ad5f41" href="#" class="text-size-medium font-color-light w-dyn-bind-empty"></a></div><div class="padding_bottom padding-2rem"></div><div class="news_cta_button_wrapper"><a data-wf-native-id-path="bc532407-4693-b915-d856-ff8ae28a6d00" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="bc532407-4693-b915-d856-ff8ae28a6d00" href="#" class="primary_button news_cta w-dyn-bind-empty w-button"></a></div></div></div></div><div class="news_body-cta_wrapper"><div class="news_cta_card"><h3 class="heading-medium"><span>#1 AI-powered customer support with human-like empathy</span></h3><div><strong>Accelerate your customer support with new-gen AI that communicates like a real human. <br>‍<br>‍</strong><strong>Automate up to 90% of support tickets with 99.8% accuracy. <script data-cmp-info="6">
  class EnegelaiBotController {
    constructor() {
      this.bot = document.querySelector('enegelai-bot');

      window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        this.bot.addEventListener('c7o:bot:botInitialized', () => {
          this.onAttach(); /* Apply styling */
          this.fadeIn(this.bot);
        });
      });
    }
  
    setValue = (value) => {
      if (!this.bot || !this.bot.setInputValue) return;
      this.bot.setInputValue(value);
    };
  
    setPlaceholder = (value) => {
      return this.textareaEl.setAttribute('placeholder', value);
    };

    styleHeader = () => {
      this.header.style.boxShadow = 'none'; 
    }

    styleUserInput = () => { 
      this.userInput.style.background = '#1a1a1a';
      this.userInput.style.color = '#FFFFFF'; 
      this.userInput.style.padding = '0px';
      let style = document.createElement('style');
      style.innerHTML = `
        .cb-input-buttons {
          width: 96px;
          position: absolute;
          right: 0px;
          bottom: 0;
          padding-right: 8px !important;
        }
      `;
      this.userInput?.shadowRoot.appendChild(style);
    }

    /***** Begin - Custom chat and voice buttons *****/
    setButtonColors = () => {
      let style = document.createElement('style');
      style.innerHTML = `
      :host {
        background-color: #BDBDBD; 
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        font-size: 16px;
        border-radius: 48px;
        opacity: 1;
        font-size: 1em !important;
      }
      :host button {
        background-color: #DEF862;
        opacity: 1;
        height: 48px;
        width: 48px !important;
        left: 0px;
        position: absolute;
      }
      
      :host button:hover {
        background-color: #DEF862 !important;
      }

      :host div.voice-div:hover {
        background-color: #D9D9D9 !important;
      }

      :host div.voice-div {
        background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg width="14" height="20" viewBox="0 0 14 20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path opacity="0.45" d="M7 12.5C8.66 12.5 9.99 11.16 9.99 9.5L10 3.5C10 1.84 8.66 0.5 7 0.5C5.34 0.5 4 1.84 4 3.5V9.5C4 11.16 5.34 12.5 7 12.5ZM12.3 9.5C12.3 12.5 9.76 14.6 7 14.6C4.24 14.6 1.7 12.5 1.7 9.5H0C0 12.91 2.72 15.73 6 16.22V19.5H8V16.22C11.28 15.74 14 12.92 14 9.5H12.3Z" fill="%231a1a1a"/></svg>');
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        margin-left: 48px;
        border-radius: 100%;
        background-color: transparent;
        background-position: center;
        height: 48px;
        width: 48px;
      }
      `;
      this.slButton?.shadowRoot.appendChild(style);
    }

    styleButtons = () => {
      this.setButtonColors();

      let svgButton = document.createElement('div');
      svgButton.className = 'voice-div';
      svgButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => { 
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        this.openVoiceControls();
      });
      this.slButton.shadowRoot.appendChild(svgButton);

      this.closeVoice = document.querySelector('.voice-control-close svg');
      this.closeVoice.addEventListener('click', (event) => { this.closeVoiceControls() });

      this.voiceMicButton = document.querySelector('.voice-control-button-mic');
      this.voiceMicButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => { this.startVoiceBotCall() });

      this.voiceMuteButton = document.querySelector('.voice-control-button-mute');
      this.voiceMuteButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => { this.muteVoiceBotCall() });

      this.voiceEndButton = document.querySelector('.voice-control-button-end');
      this.voiceEndButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => { this.endVoiceBotCall() });

      /* Arrow SVG icon */
      this.cbIcon.svg = `<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 13 13" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M1 0V2H9.59L0 11.59L1.41 13L11 3.41V12H13V0H1Z" fill="#38215F"/></svg>`;
      this.cbIcon.style.position = 'absolute';
      this.cbIcon.style.left = '16px';
      this.cbIcon.style.top = '12px'; // adjust for Webflow
    }
    /***** End - Custom chat and voice buttons *****/

    styleAnchor = () => {
      this.cbAnchor = this.anchor?.shadowRoot.querySelector('.cb-anchor');
      this.slPopup = this.cbAnchor.querySelector("sl-popup");
      this.slAnchorButton = this.slPopup?.querySelector('.anchor-button');
      this.anchorInnerButton = this.slAnchorButton?.shadowRoot.querySelector('button');
      
      this.engagePopup = this.cbAnchor.querySelector(".cb-engage-popup");
      this.engagePopup.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    }

    styleFeedbackForm = () => {
      this.feedbackForm = this.wrapper.querySelector('cb-dialog-feedback');
      this.feedbackFormDialog = this.feedbackForm?.shadowRoot.querySelector('sl-dialog');

      /* Make popup modal have rounded corners */
      this.feedbackPanel = this.feedbackFormDialog?.shadowRoot.querySelector('.dialog__panel');
      this.feedbackPanel.style.borderRadius = '30px';

      this.messageWrapper = this.feedbackFormDialog?.querySelector('.cb-feedback-messages-wrapper');
      this.messageWrapper.style.padding = '0px 16px 6px 16px';

      /* Can't style the message until it's chosen by user so this is not useful, revisit with style selectors */
      this.feedbackMessageList = this.messageWrapper?.querySelector('cb-message-list').shadowRoot;
      this.messageContent = this.feedbackMessageList?.querySelector('.cb-message__content');

      /* Style buttons at the bottom */
      this.feedbackButtons = this.feedbackFormDialog.querySelectorAll('sl-button');

      this.cancelFeedbackButton = this.feedbackButtons[0]?.shadowRoot.querySelector('button');
      this.cancelFeedbackButton.style.color = 'black';
      this.cancelFeedbackButton.style.backgroundColor = 'white';
      this.cancelFeedbackButton.style.borderColor = '#C780FF';
      this.cancelFeedbackButton.style.borderRadius = '30px';
      this.cancelFeedbackButton.style.padding = '0px 8px';

      this.feedbackSubmitButton = this.feedbackButtons[1]?.shadowRoot.querySelector('button');
      this.feedbackSubmitButton.style.color = 'black';
      this.feedbackSubmitButton.style.backgroundColor = '#DEF862';
      this.feedbackSubmitButton.style.borderColor = '#DEF862';
      this.feedbackSubmitButton.style.borderRadius = '30px';
      this.feedbackSubmitButton.style.padding = '0px 8px';
    }

    /***** Begin - Voicebot control functions *****/
    openVoiceControls = () => {
      /* Hide the text chat if applicable */
      this.bot.setOpen(false);

      /* Open the voicechat display */
      this.voiceDisplay = document.querySelector('.voice-display');
      this.voiceDisplay.style.display = 'inline-block';
      this.voiceDisplay.style.visibility = 'visible';

      /* Swap the chatbot button styling */
      let style = document.createElement('style');
      style.innerHTML = `
      :host {
        background-color: #BDBDBD; 
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        font-size: 16px;
        border-radius: 48px;
        opacity: 1;
        font-size: 1em !important;
      }
      :host button {
        background-color: #BDBDBD;
        opacity: 1;
        height: 48px;
        width: 48px !important;
        left: 0px;
        position: absolute;
      }
      
      :host div.voice-div:hover {
        background-color: #DEF862 !important;
      }

      :host div.voice-div {
        background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg width="14" height="20" viewBox="0 0 14 20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path opacity="0.45" d="M7 12.5C8.66 12.5 9.99 11.16 9.99 9.5L10 3.5C10 1.84 8.66 0.5 7 0.5C5.34 0.5 4 1.84 4 3.5V9.5C4 11.16 5.34 12.5 7 12.5ZM12.3 9.5C12.3 12.5 9.76 14.6 7 14.6C4.24 14.6 1.7 12.5 1.7 9.5H0C0 12.91 2.72 15.73 6 16.22V19.5H8V16.22C11.28 15.74 14 12.92 14 9.5H12.3Z" fill="%231a1a1a"/></svg>');
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        margin-left: 48px;
        border-radius: 100%;
        background-color: #DEF862;
        background-position: center;
        height: 48px;
        width: 48px;
      }
      `;
      this.slButton?.shadowRoot.appendChild(style);
    }

    closeVoiceControls = () => {
      /* Hang up call */
      if (this.call) {
        this.call.disconnect();
      }

      /* Reset and hide voice menu */
      this.voiceDisplay = document.querySelector('.voice-display');
      this.voiceDisplay.style.display = 'none';
      this.voiceDisplay.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      this.setButtonColors();

      this.muteButton = document.querySelector(".voice-control-button-mute");
      this.muteButton.classList.remove("mute-styling");

      /* reset gif to original SVG */
      this.voiceMicButton.style.borderColor = '#FFFFFF';
      this.voiceMicButtonSVG = document.querySelector('.voice-control-button-mic svg');
      this.voiceMicButtonSVG.style.display = 'inline-block';
      this.voiceGif = document.querySelector(".voice-gif");
      this.voiceGif.style.display = "none";
      this.voiceMicButton.classList.remove("no-hover");

      /* Reopen chat window */
      this.bot.setOpen(true);
    }

    startVoiceBotCall = async () => {
      const params = {
        To: this.phoneNumber,
      };

      if (this.device) {
        this.call = await this.device.connect({ params });

        this.call.on("accept", () => {
          /* Change styling to show gif, hide SVG, hide border */
          this.voiceMicButton.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
          this.voiceMicButtonSVG = document.querySelector('.voice-control-button-mic svg');
          this.voiceMicButtonSVG.style.display = 'none';
          this.voiceGif = document.querySelector(".voice-gif");
          this.voiceGif.style.display = "inline-block";
          this.voiceMicButton.classList.add("no-hover");
        });
      } else {
        console.log('Unable to make call.');
      }
    };

    muteVoiceBotCall = () => {
      this.muteButton = document.querySelector(".voice-control-button-mute");
      if (this.call) {
        if (this.call.isMuted()) {
          this.muteButton.classList.remove("mute-styling");
          this.call.mute(false);
        } else {
          this.muteButton.classList.add("mute-styling");
          this.call.mute(true);
        }
      }
    }

    endVoiceBotCall = () => {
      if (this.call) {
        this.call.disconnect();
      }
      this.muteButton = document.querySelector(".voice-control-button-mute");
      this.muteButton.classList.remove("mute-styling");
      this.closeVoiceControls();
    }

    initializeTwilio = async () => {
      this.identity = 'the_user_id';
      this.phoneNumber = '+18884108077';

      await this.getToken();

      this.device = new Twilio.Device(this.token, {
        debug: true,
        answerOnBridge: true,
        /*
        * Set Opus as our preferred codec. Opus generally performs better, requiring less bandwidth and
        * providing better audio quality in restrained network conditions. Opus will be default in 2.0.
        */
        codecPreferences: ['opus', 'pcmu'],
      });

      /* Listen for Twilio.Device states */
      this.addDeviceListeners(this.device);

      /* Device must be registered in order to receive incoming calls */
      this.device.register();
    }

    getToken = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('https://quickstart-voice-javascript-sdk-6444-dev.twil.io/voice-token');
        const { identity, token } = await response.json();
        if (response.ok) {
          this.identity = identity;
          this.token = token;
        } else {
          console.error(`Response status: ${response.status}`);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error: ', e);
      }
    };

    addDeviceListeners = (device) => {
      device.on('registered', function () {
        console.log('Twilio.Device Ready to make and receive calls!');
      });

      device.on('error', function (error) {
        console.log(`Twilio.Device Error: ${error.message}`);
      });
    };
    /***** End - Voicebot control functions *****/

    fadeIn = (el) => {
      el.style.opacity = 0;
      
      let opacity = 0;
      let request;

      const animation = () => {
          el.style.opacity = opacity += 0.04;
          if (opacity >= 1) {
              opacity = 1;
              cancelAnimationFrame(request);
          }
      };

      const rAf = () => {
          request = requestAnimationFrame(rAf);
          animation();
      };
      rAf();
    };

    onAttach = () => {
      this.wrapper = this.bot.shadowRoot.querySelector('.cb-wrapper');
      this.anchor = this.bot.shadowRoot.querySelector('cb-anchor');
      this.header = this.bot.shadowRoot.querySelector('cb-header');
      this.userInput = this.wrapper.querySelector('cb-user-input');
      this.slButton = this.userInput?.shadowRoot.querySelector('sl-button');
      this.cbIcon = this.userInput?.shadowRoot.querySelector('cb-icon');
      this.textarea = this.userInput?.shadowRoot.querySelector('sl-textarea');
      this.textareaEl = this.textarea?.shadowRoot.querySelector('textarea');
      this.messageList = this.bot.shadowRoot.querySelector('cb-message-list');

      this.setPlaceholder('Try our AI Assistant');

      /* We need to set styles in JS because we cannot apply CSS to shadow DOM at a global level via CSS */
      this.styleAnchor();
      this.styleFeedbackForm();
      this.styleHeader();
      this.styleUserInput();
      this.styleButtons();

      /* Style text area */
      this.messageList.style.padding = '0px 14px';

      this.textareaEl?.addEventListener('focus', () => {
        /* If the voice controls are open (while user opens chatbot), hang up call and close voice controls */
        this.closeVoiceControls();
      });

      this.initializeTwilio();
    };
  }

  const botController = new EnegelaiBotController();  
  // Automatically open bot on /demo, and keep it minimized elsewhere
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const bot = document.querySelector('enegelai-bot');
  if (bot) {
    if (window.location.pathname === '/demo') {
      bot.setOpen(true); // Open on crescendo.ai/demo
    } else {
      bot.setOpen(false); // Minimized elsewhere
    }
  }
});
</script>
